meyhane.title: Squid, rakı and meze lanes
meyhane.story: Bozcaada's meyhanes sit on two short streets in the town centre, not on the harbour. On Çınar Çarşı, Asmalı Meyhane has grilled island kalamar on coals and served raw fish with basil since Niko Manalodis and his brothers opened it in 1950. Around the corner on Alsancak Sokak, the old bazaar street, Sandal fills Apostol Kalfa's former coffeehouse, keeping its cedar floors, and lists island herb salad and mastic artichoke among its meze. A few doors along, Nevreste seats dinner under a yediveren rose tree and opens with the Bozcaada Bombası, a stuffed meze no other house makes. The rhythm is the same everywhere: cold meze, hot meze, then fish, with rakı.
meyhane.where: Asmalı Meyhane, Çınar Çarşı Caddesi; Sandal, Alsancak Sokak; Nevreste, Alsancak Sokak

home.title: Mantı and the cook's plates
home.story: Away from the fish grills, Bozcaada eats from pots: dumplings, olive-oil vegetables, leaves rolled round rice, the food of the Turkish and Rum households that shaped the town. Dört Hanımeli was opened more than forty years ago by retired primary-school teachers, and reviewers still come for its mantı, its vine-leaf sarma and stuffed courgette flowers. On Alsancak Sokak, Ada'm, about ten years old, shows what an island cook does with the same pantry, putting octopus with artichokes in a cream sauce and wrapping sea bass in vine leaves. Both are plain rooms where the plates are the point, and cheaper than the courtyard meze houses.
home.where: Dört Hanımeli, Bozcaada town; Ada'm, Alsancak Sokak

cellar.title: Island grapes, three ways
cellar.story: Bozcaada's wine rests on four native grapes, Çavuş and Vasilaki for white, Karalahna and Kuntra for red, and its cellars divide three ways. Talay is the old family firm: brothers founded it in 1948, bottling began in 1955, and today you taste a paid flight at a shop in town. Corvus is the architect's estate at Tuzburnu, where Reşit Soley makes Corpus, about two-thirds Cabernet, and a dry wine from the Çavuş table grape. Amadeus MMX is the Gareis family's small cellar, begun as a hobby in 2010, growing Grillo and Croatian Žlahtina beside native Vasilaki. Out of season, call each one first: none publishes winter hours.
cellar.where: Talay Şarapçılık, town centre; Corvus, Tuzburnu; Amadeus MMX, among the vines outside town

street.title: Jam, cookies and the market
street.story: The island's street food is mostly sweet and mostly sold from jars and counters. On market day, Wednesday in most sources, growers sell tomatoes, fruit and cheese, with tomato jam, fig jam and garlic confit in jars; the market has moved from the square older guides give, so ask in town where it stands. Çiçek Pastanesi bakes in a stone oven over wood and sells the mastic-almond cookie of the Rum kitchen, also made on Gökçeada and in Kavala, with mastic and wild-fig ice cream from the counter next door. In winter, check both: the pastane's island branch may open only in summer.
street.where: The weekly market, in town; Çiçek Pastanesi, Rum quarter
